headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.

headlines.title: Mike Ditka, legendary Chicago Bears coach, dies at 86
headlines.description: Legendary Chicago Bears coach Mike Ditka, who led the team to its only Super Bowl victory in 1986, has died, his family announced.

headlines.title: Candidates Face Off in Debates; Kimberly Guilfoyle Under Scrutiny
headlines.description: With the midterm elections fast approaching, fierce debates were held in three critical races Thursday night. It comes as a recent NBC News poll found that inflation and the cost of issue is the top issue for voters with government corruption coming in at No. 2. Now, President Donald Trump’s ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, is under growing scrutiny after a top Trump donor alleged she asked him to pay her $100,00 American Express bill. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: With all eyes on Texas Senate race, James Talarico has vanished from the campaign trail
headlines.description: In final stretch of the Texas Senate race, Talarico has not appeared in person since Sept. 26; he is expected to be back this weekend.

headlines.title: Trump establishes panel to probe Fed governor Lisa Cook in latest attempt to fire her
headlines.description: President Donald Trump established a committee to investigate Fed governor Lisa Cook, in his latest attempt to fire her.

headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias Strengthens to Category 2; Heads for Gulf Coast
headlines.description: The Gulf Coast is bracing for impact as a strengthened Hurricane Isaias barrels towards shore. The Category 2 hurricane is sparking evacuation orders across parts of the Florida panhandle and neighboring Alabama. NBC’s Jesse Kirsch reports and TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer looks at when it’s expected to make landfall.

headlines.title: Navi Pillay, who led U.N. panel that found Israel committed genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize
headlines.description: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navanethem “Navi” Pillay

headlines.title: Man Shot in Car by ICE in New York as 5-Year-Old Sat in Backseat
headlines.description: Outrage and intense protests erupted in New York after ICE agents opened fire on a 28-year-old man in a car with a 5-year-old child in the backseat. The Department of Homeland Security says it was part of a “targeted enforcement operation” and said in a statement they were seeking an “illegal alien from the Dominican Republic” who has a criminal history. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth Vows to Livestream Execution of Fort Hood Shooter
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is announcing that for the first time ever, a U.S. military execution will be livestreamed, allowing people around the world to watch it. The person set to be put to death by firing squad is the shooter behind the 2009 mass shooting at Fort Hood. NBC’s Ryan Chandler reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: In new Elon Musk documentary, his lieutenants are the most damning voices
headlines.description: ‘Musk,’ the new film from Alex Gibney, features interviews with more than the usual critics of the Tesla and SpaceX CEO.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: They were a historically bad team. Now they’re a threat to make the World Series.
headlines.description: The Chicago White Sox are up 2-0 in the American League Division Series, a shocking turnaround after three straight 100-loss seasons.
